review_eligibility: Temporal stack must beat fixed blend on point log loss and summed-class Brier, with paired weekly log-loss difference upper 95% percentile bound below zero, in selection AND confirmation. It must also beat legacy point log loss and Brier in both intervals. Otherwise retain defaults and record inferior/inconclusive result. No automatic promotion in any case.
selection_order: Write selection metrics and decision before evaluating confirmation; no refit or tuning after selection
structural_acceptance: Every validation row predicted by models fit only on earlier dates; no source match across boundary; burn-in excluded from meta fitting; all final base members refit on training only; invalid metadata/probabilities fail closed
limits: Historical retrospective comparison; confirmation is reserved within this experiment, not guaranteed uncontaminated by earlier project development
2016 selection outcomes were observed during the earlier lifecycle rehearsal
Known-prior match outcomes may update causal rolling features during each later interval; not all forecasts issued at training cutoff
Weekly bootstrap approximates dependence; repeated teams and cross-week dependence remain
One preset CPU configuration, one historical train/selection/confirmation sequence; no broad predictive superiority claim
No change to serving default, approval state, cloud schedule or public deployment
